bootstrap.unit: feasible scenario; all delays and policies resampled together; paired percentile intervals

statistics.paired_tests: Exact two-sided sign tests of scenario-level differences; aggregate uses per-scenario counts across all 11 delays; ties excluded, all ties p=1
statistics.multiplicity: Holm adjustment jointly across all 180 aggregate/per-delay baseline×metric tests
statistics.interpretation: Outcome CIs condition on feasible calibration; a scenario, not a scenario-delay pair, is the resampling unit. Percentile CIs can be degenerate for zero observed events; complementary scenario-any-unsafe Wilson intervals are included.

scientific_configuration.calibration: Unchanged official D=0-only maximum dwell; first candidate on ties; require 180ms

bootstrap.unit: feasible scenario; all delays and policies resampled together; paired percentile intervals

scientific_configuration.paired_inference: Exact two-sided scenario-level sign tests; ties excluded; Holm adjustment over 180 aggregate/per-delay comparisons (5 baselines x 3 metrics x 12 strata)
scientific_configuration.feasibility_ci: Wilson binomial 95% interval over exactly 300 attempted scenarios
scientific_configuration.reuse: Always-Recover D=0 equals original; positive delays share the nominal fallback. Fixed TTL uses original or nominal fallback; native checks at D=.3/.4 for every feasible scene.
scientific_configuration.test_adaptation: None; smoke scenes remain in final cohort and measured checkpoints are retained
